authority: HAND-MAINTAINED. The machine form of the approved study sessions in the topic pack. No tool writes this file.
what_this_is: The topic pack is a document a human reads; this is the same approved sessions as data, so the workbook can render them as clickable tasks without a brittle Markdown parser. Each topic pins ITS OWN pack by sha256: if a pack is edited and this file is not, validation fails closed rather than shipping a stale plan. There is exactly one session schema and every topic uses it.

identity: session_id is the identity (D01-S01, D03-S02 ...). session_number is the ORDER within a topic and is what the cockpit counts against sessions_completed. Titles are never identity, so a retitled session keeps its id and a reordered one keeps its number.

task_fields.question_id: canonical id, or null. The URL is DERIVED by tools/study/study_links.py and never stored -- a stored URL is an unchecked claim
task_fields.reason: why this task earns its place in the session

entry_exit: entry_state / advances_status_to are the session's states in the progression declared by study_progress.json. D01 sessions 2-5 carry null exit states because the approved Topic 01 pack declared a completion signal for Session 1 only; that is preserved rather than invented.
